scope: bounded native fused expert binding and synthetic cost pilot
correctness_before_timing: exact Python-MLX/native binding bits on selected real rows
timing: Same shapes, data, affine controls and repetitions as fused-v1. CPU routing validation and private index preparation occur before timing, matching prevalidated affine indices. Casts, dispatch, evaluation and synchronization remain timed.
limitations: Shared reviewed Metal kernels make this a binding comparison, not an independent arithmetic oracle.
VQ 2.1 row bytes may be used as fixtures with the declared newer runtime; that is not VQ 2.1 runtime parity.
Synthetic routing, resident weights and timings cannot qualify a full model or hardware profile.
Candidate quality, whole-model parity and mixed storage remain separate gates.
change: Remove the redundant GPU bounds-reduction synchronization. The prepared operation privately owns validated indices and retains its input array context. No arithmetic or packing change.
